messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — Predictive Prefetch pilot needs final gating: runtime perf, infra capacity, security review. Can we align owners + acceptance criteria? Keep replies short, we’ll capture actions.

Mike (Eng Runtime): +1. Need baseline QPS, target p99, and cache eviction behavior under burst.

Ravi (Eng Infra): We can reserve a Dedicated pool for the pilot (2x A100 equiv). What’s expected token throughput and ramp profile? Also need staging window.

Anya (PM): Target numbers: 5k reqs/min peak, avg ~150 tokens per request, p99 generation <= 300ms. Pilot target start: 2027-05-12. Staging: 1 week prior.

Sofia (Security): Security asks: threat model + dataflow diagram, KMS for keys, SSO for test tenants, plus audit log retention. Who owns docs?

Mike (Eng Runtime): I’ll produce a small dataflow + test plan by EOD tomorrow. Also will validate KV-cache eviction and prefix caching on synthetic burst.

Lindsay (Product Ops): Suggest rollout/rollback criteria: a) p99 > 400ms for 5m OR b) error rate > 1% for 5m => automatic rollback. Also need canary percentage and duration.

Anya (PM): Agreed. Proposed acceptance checklist (to be filled):
```
- Perf: p99 <= 300ms on pilot traffic profile
- Stability: error rate < 0.5%
- Security: threat model reviewed + KMS configured
- Observability: traces + token-level cost enabled
- Rollout: 5% canary for 10m, then 25% for 20m, then full
- Rollback: automated on criteria above
```

Ravi (Eng Infra): Ops note: autoscale warmup ~3m, so prewarm should kick off ~5m before scheduled ramp. We’ll provision buffer capacity and a prewarm job. Canary: 5% traffic for 10m with metrics gating. Audit logs retention: 90d, configurable.

Mike (Eng Runtime): Canary routing: route-rule -> fallback to smaller model variant on errors. I’ll draft routing policy and quantization/instancing notes.

Sofia (Security): Also confirm: any tenant data used in tests needs explicit opt-in and data masking. If so, add privacy flag and dataflow approval step.

Anya (PM): Owners (confirmed): Anya — product, Mike — runtime, Ravi — infra, Sofia — security, Lindsay — ops. Action items assigned in thread.

deploy-bot: Scheduled placeholder: canary rollout 2027-05-12T15:00Z (will be updated in the console).

Mike (Eng Runtime): I’ll open a short RFC + checklist doc in /docs/pilot-prefetch and ping security when diagrams are posted.

Sofia (Security): Will review diagrams within 24h of posting. If anything shows external data transfer, we escalate to compliance.

Anya (PM): Thanks everyone — next short sync Thu 11:00 PT. If you can’t make it, post updates here.

Ravi (Eng Infra): Noted. I’ll add prewarm job config and autoscale knobs to the draft.

Lindsay (Product Ops): I’ll prepare the rollback runbook and communicate the staging window to customer success.

Mike (Eng Runtime): tagging @mike-eng for canary config review, and @sofia-sec for security checks.

Anya (PM): Closing — we’ll convert this thread into an action list after the RFC is up. :thumbsup:
